words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.ex: The economist predicts higher prices next year.
words.ex_cn: 这位经济学家预测明年价格会上涨。
words.en: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

words.ex: He is taking business studies at high school.
words.ex_cn: 他在高中学习商业研究。
words.en: Business studies is an academic subject that teaches the principles of business, management, and economics.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.ex: She is a successful businesswoman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位成功的女商人。
words.en: A businesswoman is a woman who works in business, especially one who has a high position in a company.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.tr: phrase. 获得一个位置；找到一个地方
words.ex: She worked hard to get a place at the university.
words.ex_cn: 她努力学习以获得大学的一个位置。
words.en: To obtain a position or location.

words.tr: phrase. 攻读学位；为获得学位而学习
words.ex: She decided to study for a degree in biology to pursue her passion for environmental conservation.
words.ex_cn: 她决定攻读生物学学位，以追求她对环境保护的热情。
words.en: To engage in learning at a college or university in order to obtain a degree.

words.ex: He wants to do a degree in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他想攻读计算机科学学位。
words.en: To study for a university degree.

words.ex: He completed the task successfully.
words.ex_cn: 他成功地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that accomplishes a desired aim or result.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.tr: n. 教学；授课；教导； v. 教；教导；“teach”的现在分词；
words.ex: Teaching is his favorite part of the job.
words.ex_cn: 教学是他工作中最喜欢的部分。
words.en: The work or profession of a teacher; the act of imparting knowledge or skills.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: He majored in arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修人文学科。
words.en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, film, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express important meanings or ideas.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.tr: phrase. v. 继续去做（某事）；接着做；之后从事
words.ex: He did well in school and went on to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校表现很好，后来成为了一名医生。
words.en: To proceed or continue to do something after completing something else.

words.tr: phrase. 研究生学位；硕士或博士学位
words.ex: She decided to pursue a postgraduate degree in environmental science.
words.ex_cn: 她决定攻读环境科学的研究生学位。
words.en: A postgraduate degree is an academic degree pursued after completing an undergraduate degree. It includes master's degrees and doctoral degrees, among others.

words.tr: phrase. 进行研究；从事调查工作
words.ex: He does research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他研究气候变化。
words.en: To conduct systematic investigation or study to discover facts or information.
